text:
ana: Opening thread to align on a compact onboarding SLA + migration playbook for small-model families where we expect frequent minor updates. Goal: keep process lightweight but safe.
carl: Important we avoid heavy canary steps for tiny updates. Maybe shadow + 10% ramp default.
beatrice: Agree. For frequent minor updates (bugfixes, tokenizer tweaks) propose: shadow (automated smoke) -> 10% canary -> 100% if no alerts after 1hr.
nana: Typo: it's ana not nana :)
nana: ops-bot: noted.
nana: For metrics, define a cheap eval probe set (50 examples) per family with microbenchmarks and a quick perceptual pass-rate threshold (no more than 2% regression).
carl: Also include a 'no-structural-change' gate: config parity check (vocab size, embedding dims). Otherwise go through full onboarding.
beatrice: Pin behavior: allow auto-soft-pin 14d for customers who opt-in in advance; otherwise default 7d. Hard pin false by default.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Minor rollout initiated: tiny-lm v1.5 -> v1.6 shadow at 2024-02-11T08:12Z.
nana: Quick rollback snippet for tiny-lm:
```sh
redwoodctl rollback --family tiny-lm --to v1.5 --reason "canary alert"
```
nana: Action items: ana -> document lightweight checklist; carl -> implement shadow smoke and 10% ramp feature flag; beatrice -> define 50-example probe sets and register them.
beatrice: I'll pick 3 cohorts (shortcompletion, summarization, embed-sim) and create probes.
carl: Will add auto-flush cache hook for tiny-lm flows.
nana: Let's reconvene Wed to review checklist. :ok_hand:
